owner: Happy CLI native app-server notification observer

publicApis.notApplicableReason: No public protocol or request shape changes; the existing notification is observed locally.

budgets.field: per-runtime diagnostic admission and output privacy
budgets.enforcement: createCodexRawItemDiagnostics requires an exact selected Happy session, admits 16 normal plus 128 generic-ID samples before formatting, emits only fixed allowlisted metadata through local-only diagnosticTrace, and catches extraction failures
budgets.phase: rawResponseItem/completed callback before existing bridge handling
budgets.errorKind: drop diagnostics without changing the provider event or failing the callback

lifecycleTransitions.notApplicableReason: No provider, account, input or history lifecycle changes; observer counters are runtime-local and never drive recovery.

provenanceFields.notApplicableReason: Diagnostic hashes correlate observations only and are not security or recovery authority.
